# USHA by NJO

> USHA by NJO · Business intelligence engine. Where is the truth? Hidden in the algorithms. USHA reads them. Not a chatbot. Built by NJO Business Solutions (since 2016) for brands and marketplace sellers in Russia, the GCC and Egypt. First week free.

USHA is a business intelligence engine, not a chatbot or an agency. She works in the client's messenger 24/7. Every day, before 08:00, she reads 1,240 sources: marketplaces, competitors, reviews, search and ads. The English deck names Amazon, noon, Ozon and Wildberries; the Russian deck names Ozon, Wildberries and Yandex Market. She reports what changed and why, then does the work within an approved plan. Every output is checked against NJO's quality standards. Sources: updated decks, slides 3, 7, 13, 21 and 23.

AI sells answers. We take responsibility for ours. Money-back terms are written into your contract. NDA · signed before day one. Sources: slides 25–26. No refund period or sales outcome is promised here.

- [USHA — English](https://usha.one/en/): USHA by NJO reads your marketplaces, competitors and buyers every day, tells you what changed and why, and does the work: strategy, content, ads. Russia, GCC, Egypt. First week free.

## Plans
- USHA Core: The engine for one brand, one marketplace, one ad platform. Up to 5 competitors tracked; 1 marketplace; Up to 16 posts · 32 stories; Up to 4 videos · 1 photo shoot; 1 ad platform · 1 promotion.
- USHA Pro: More reach and output, plus customer replies and stock intelligence. Up to 10 competitors tracked; Up to 3 marketplaces; Up to 20 posts · 40 stories; Packaging design · customer replies; 2 ad platforms · 2 promotions.
- USHA Enterprise: For groups and larger companies. Configured around your company. Everything in Pro; Operations and stock; Dashboards, websites, automations; Scope agreed individually.
- “Up to” is a monthly maximum; your exact plan is agreed at the start. Advertising budgets, creator fees and products for collaborations are paid separately.
